name: text-rewriter
description: Rewrites text to remove AI-generated linguistic patterns, puffery, and formulaic language. Use when the user wants to rewrite, clean up, or de-AI any text — from pasted input or files.
author: JJ Halans

usage.prompt: Accept text (pasted or file path), load references/ai-writing-guide.md, apply all rules to rewrite for style without changing meaning, then save to a -rewritten output file and display a summary of changes.

text.description: Text pasted directly by the user to rewrite.

filePath.description: Path to a file whose contents should be rewritten.

outputFile.description: Path to the saved rewritten file (same directory as input, with -rewritten before the extension).

summary.description: Brief summary of patterns removed and notable changes made.
